INTEGRATED SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Acids, Bases and Indicators? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Acids, Bases and Indicators.

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Integrated Science? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Integrated Science.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Integrated Science.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Integrated Science.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Integrated Science.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures.

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Reproductive System? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproductive System.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproductive System.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproductive System.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Magnetism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Integrated Science and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory apparatus and instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
